data.text: If you use the form on the contact page, I receive your name, your email address, and your message. The form is relayed by Web3Forms, a third-party service, which delivers it to my email inbox.
If you write to contact@yesid.dev, I receive whatever you choose to send me.
If you book a call, the booking runs on cal.com. You provide your name, your email address, and the meeting details; cal.com shares them with me so the meeting can happen.

Measurement is always on. Plausible uses no cookies, no browser storage and no persistent identifier, and it does not follow you across sites, devices or apps. It has no function that identifies, locates or profiles you within the meaning of section 8.1 of the Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector: the approximate location comes from the request's IP address, which is then discarded, so there is nothing to switch on. This is collection under section 8 of that Act for the purpose stated above. For visitors covered by the EU General Data Protection Regulation, the basis is my legitimate interest in understanding how the site is used (Article 6(1)(f)); it does not override your rights because no one is identified, profiled or tracked. You can object at any time by writing to contact@yesid.dev, or block plausible.io in your browser. Plausible keeps no record of individual visitors, so there is nothing about you to retrieve or delete.

items.content: To respond to your message.

data.text: I use your information for nothing else. If I ever needed it for a new purpose, I would ask for your consent first.

cal.com: handles call booking.
Railway and Neon: run the backend of my content system. They never process visitor data; the published site is static and makes no calls to them.
Plausible Analytics (Plausible Insights OÜ, Estonia): processes the limited site-measurement data described above. Visitor data is processed and stored in the European Union.

description.en: I take things apart to learn how they work, then build better ones.
description.fr: Je démonte les choses pour comprendre comment elles marchent, puis j'en construis de meilleures.
description.es: Desarmo las cosas para entender cómo funcionan, y luego construyo unas mejores.

description.en: If it works but it's ugly, it's only half done.
description.fr: Si ça fonctionne mais que c'est laid, ce n'est qu'à moitié fait.
description.es: Si funciona pero es feo, solo está hecho a medias.

description.en: Good tools lift the people around them, that’s the whole point.
description.fr: Les bons outils élèvent les gens autour d'eux, c'est tout l'intérêt.
description.es: Las buenas herramientas impulsan a quienes las rodean, de eso se trata todo.

description.en: I'd rather build it right than build it twice.
description.fr: Je préfère bien le bâtir que le bâtir deux fois.
description.es: Prefiero construirlo bien a construirlo dos veces.

quote.en: You have the gift of perseverance, and that's what makes you a genius too.
quote.fr: Tu as le don de la persévérance, et c'est ce qui fait de toi un génie.
quote.es: Tienes el don de la perseverancia, y eso es lo que también te hace un genio.

quote.en: What matters in life is not what happens to you but what you remember and how you remember it.
quote.fr: Ce qui compte dans la vie, ce n'est pas ce qui t'arrive, mais ce dont tu te souviens et la façon dont tu t'en souviens.
quote.es: La vida no es la que uno vivió, sino la que uno recuerda y cómo la recuerda para contarla.

quote.en: Everything we hear is an opinion, not a fact. Everything we see is a perspective, not the truth.
quote.fr: Tout ce que nous entendons est une opinion, pas un fait. Tout ce que nous voyons est une perspective, pas la vérité.
quote.es: Todo lo que oímos es una opinión, no un hecho. Todo lo que vemos es una perspectiva, no la verdad.
